name: Northstar shared detailed basemap
notes: All features are fictional and authored; coordinates are metres in a non-georeferenced engineering grid, never GPS.
Static detail is published from Transit into a shared release. Runtime services serve local copies and require no cross-service map request.
District representative points and facility anchors are unchanged. Original feature IDs and coordinates are preserved.
Building district labels follow the footprint centre; authored_cluster_id retains the generator group. A footprint may cross a district boundary.
Full-region coverage preserves rural anchors and regional roads; dense buildings exist only in the six authored urban/coastal clusters.
Road crossings are not newly inferred junctions. No intersections, routing costs or operational network edges are changed.
Landmarks may share a coordinate. Domain overlays remain separate from the immutable base; no person, incident or worker records are part of this file.

publication.workplace_policy: Live registered office workplaces remain a separately identified Transit overlay; no database snapshot is embedded.

reference.description: Planar metre coordinates in a fictional engineering grid. No Earth location or EPSG transformation is defined.
